entities.summary: Šilalė is a city in western Lithuania, Samogitia, Tauragė County. It is located 30 km (19 mi) north of Tauragė. The River Lokysta flows through the town and there is a pond in the centre of the town. Šilalė is a city in Northern Europe. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
